title: How to blot a stain instead of rubbing

pieces.say: Stop rubbing that stain. You're making it worse.
pieces.text: Stop rubbing that stain. You're making it worse.
pieces.label: STOP DOING THIS

pieces.say: Here's the move that works. Blot from the outside in.
Act while the stain is still wet.
Press a clean white cloth. Don't scrub.
Keep blotting with a fresh area until colour stops lifting.
Don't mix stain removers with bleach. Check the care label.
The stain lifts instead of spreading.

result.say: The stain lifts instead of spreading.
result.headline: Lifts, not spreads
